data.title: Markdown
data.tagline: Write structured text with lightweight punctuation
data.description: Markdown uses simple characters for headings, lists, links, code, and emphasis. It is convenient for documentation and content stored as plain text. Different renderers support different extensions, so preview the actual output and treat embedded HTML carefully.

distinctions.label: Rich-text editor
distinctions.explanation: Markdown uses punctuation for headings, bold text, and lists, so you edit plain text. A rich-text editor shows formatted content directly, like a familiar document app.

use: Organize context for AI with headings, lists and code blocks
Save structured AI output for further editing
Write README files and project documents as versionable plain text
Keep plain-text notes readable across editors
avoid: Paste without checking Markdown support: preview first, or convert to plain text
Convert or export separately when Word is required, keeping the original .md file
Use repeated spaces or arbitrary line breaks for alignment across renderers
Open a fenced code block without closing it, so later prose becomes code

lessonPractice.title: A team will maintain a README with procedures and commands through Git. Which delivery format fits best?

options.label: Use Markdown headings, lists, and code blocks, then check the rendered preview
options.feedback: Markdown keeps readable structure in plain text, so commands remain copyable and changes can be reviewed line by line.

options.label: Lay it out in a document editor and commit an image of every page
options.feedback: Images preserve appearance, but their text is difficult to copy, search, and compare line by line.

options.label: Use plain text and align sections with repeated spaces and blank lines
options.feedback: Editors use different fonts and wrapping widths, so spacing cannot reliably express headings, lists, or code boundaries.

data.agentPrompt: Restructure this README as Markdown: use headings for hierarchy, lists for steps, and fenced code blocks for copyable commands. Do not align with repeated spaces, and verify the rendered preview and every closing fence.
